## Voxel51 - Senior Software Engineer, Python

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/voxel51/jobs/4726882005)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Python APIs, SDKs, and enterprise systems for Voxel51’s AI data platform. Scaling unstructured vision datasets and contributing to open source.
Senior Software Engineer building Python APIs and open-source AI data tools at Voxel51
- Salary: $200,000 - $225,000 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, NoSQL, Open Source, Python, TypeScript
- Develop the open source SDK, enterprise APIs, UIs, and backend systems
- Scale the enterprise solution, deployed into customers' own cloud and on premises, to support very large vision AI datasets and process petabytes of data
- Write maintainable, flexible, performant, well-tested production code
- Contribute tooling, automation, and best practices to the department
- Collaborate on features supporting dataset curation, model analysis, and integrations across the machine learning lifecycle
- Build scalable APIs and solve challenges involving unstructured image and video data
- Contribute to the open source community and enterprise-grade engineering for commercial products
- 8+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience developing maintainable and scalable systems and software architectures
- BS or MS in computer science or a related field
- Expertise with Python
- Expertise with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB, Elasticsearch)
- Experience maintaining or contributing to open source projects (or the passion to start!)
- Ability to work in a remote-first, collaborative environment
- Experience with Typescript is an asset

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Python APIs, SDKs, and enterprise systems for Voxel51’s AI data platform. Scaling unstructured vision datasets and contributing to open source.
Senior Software Engineer building Python APIs and open-source AI data tools at Voxel51
Role description:
• Develop the open source SDK, enterprise APIs, UIs, and backend systems
• Scale the enterprise solution, deployed into customers' own cloud and on premises, to support very large vision AI datasets and process petabytes of data
• Write maintainable, flexible, performant, well-tested production code
• Contribute tooling, automation, and best practices to the department
• Collaborate on features supporting dataset curation, model analysis, and integrations across the machine learning lifecycle
• Build scalable APIs and solve challenges involving unstructured image and video data
• Contribute to the open source community and enterprise-grade engineering for commercial products
Role requirements:
• 8+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience developing maintainable and scalable systems and software architectures
• BS or MS in computer science or a related field
• Expertise with Python
• Expertise with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB, Elasticsearch)
• Experience maintaining or contributing to open source projects (or the passion to start!)
• Ability to work in a remote-first, collaborative environment
• Experience with Typescript is an asset
Benefits:
• Equity in the form of options
• A variety of benefits
• Flexible work arrangements inherent in a human-first, fully remote organization
• Opportunity to grow in an exciting and collaborative environment
• At least 2 in-person retreats per year
Tech stack:
Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, NoSQL, Open Source, Python, TypeScript
